title: Staging Recovery System Surface P0 closure
summary: Expose bounded Staging-only Recovery planning and access-repair authority through the Admin System Layer, correct the Staging capability semantics from discovery-only to governed control-plane, and align the private Recovery Action bridge descriptor/handler with the v2 typed-confirmation contract.

environment_impact.reason: Shared http-generic-api runtime code changes, while the new tools themselves are hidden and denied outside Staging.

behavioral_contract: Staging canary planning writes only the durable Recovery control-plane plan and does not execute the canary.
Staging access-repair prepare resolves target identity server-side and accepts no SQL, command, database identifier, provider control, or Production target.
Staging access-repair approval issues a single-use signed execution ticket server-side and does not perform the database mutation itself.
Staging-only tools are neither advertised nor callable in Production runtime.
Recovery Action system-layer execution uses approval_id + expected_sha + exact typed_confirmation and does not accept caller approval-token material on the advertised v2 schema.
No Production, database, provider, DNS, deployment, or workflow-dispatch mutation is performed by this P0 change itself.
